description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-27 under road-to-a-prompt-that-deepens-not-widens 1.1-1.2, which moved the per-task evidence table into this skill. Exemplars are the moments a completion claim is about to be made, in English and German, including non-code work the new table rows cover. Near-misses ask for the pipeline itself (quality-tools), for wrapping up a branch (finishing-a-development-branch) or for writing a test first (test-driven-development). Counterexamples guard 'verify' in an identity or email sense.

queries.q: I think the feature is done, can we commit?
all tests should pass now, ready to open the PR
the analysis report is finished — mark the step complete
before you say it works, show me the evidence for this migration
run PHPStan, Rector and ECS on the project
queries.note: asks for the quality pipeline itself, not the gate on a claim → quality-tools

queries.q: wrap up this branch and decide whether to merge or open a PR
write a failing test for this bug before fixing it
verify the user's email address on signup
how do I verify my GitHub account?
